name: Dr Gowthami |  DrG Explains
caption:
❤️ Good parenting isn’t about doing everything for our children or making them figure everything out alone.

It’s about knowing when to step in and when to step back. 🤍

Let them try, make mistakes, feel their emotions, and learn—with the reassurance that you’re always there when they need you. 🌱

The goal isn’t to raise children who never need us, but children who feel secure enough to become independent. 🫶🏻

name: Bridget Levine | Baby Food | Motherhood | Style
caption:
If your baby isn’t sleeping through the night- this is what SAVED me and got my baby’s to sleep through the night at 3 months. I cover everything in this guide! Comment SCHEDULE and I’ll send you the complete guide.

Here’s why your baby might not be sleeping through the night:

• They aren’t getting enough calories during the day
• Wake windows are off
• They’re relying on being fed or rocked to fall asleep
• Their circadian rhythm isn’t supported

Sleep is a skill.
And it starts from the very beginning.

When you:
• Put baby down awake
• Prioritize full daytime feeds
• Use a dark, cool room with white noise
• Stay consistent with bedtime

Everything changes.

name: MOM & BABY SPA CENTER | KOMUNITAS IBU BERDAYA
caption:
Bagi anak-anak, bermain adalah aktivitas seru untuk mengisi waktu luang atau mengusir kebosanan. Tapi, tahukah Anda bahwa bermain juga merupakan media pembelajaran yang efektif? 😍🙌🏻

Dengan bermain, anak dapat mengeksplorasi lingkungan sekitarnya, memahami konsep-konsep baru, dan mengembangkan berbagai keterampilan penting serta meningkatkan percaya diri dan sosial kemandirian 🤗 Jadi, mengapa tidak menggabungkan bermain dan belajar menjadi satu pengalaman yang menyenangkan dan efektif?

Selain itu bermain sambil belajar atau biasa dikenal dengan “learning by playing” bukanlah konsep baru, namun tetap relevan dan efektif hingga saat ini. Melalui pendekatan ini, anak-anak dapat belajar sambil berinteraksi dengan lingkungan dan objek di sekitarnya, memecahkan masalah, dan berimajinasi. Di sini, kita akan membahas mengapa bermain sambil belajar penting dan bagaimana cara menerapkannya, serta memberikan beberapa ide seru untuk bermain sambil belajar bersama si buah hati 😆❤️ 

Boleh nih bunda sharing, permainan di rumah bersama si kecil apa aja nih?? 😆

name: Poets ™
caption:
Sometimes, “How was school?” is just too easy to answer with a simple “fine.” ❤️‍🩹

Kids don’t always know how to explain what happened during their day, especially when something is embarrassing, confusing, upsetting, or even surprisingly wonderful. Sometimes they need a question that gives them a little more room to talk. 🥹💭

Try asking things like:
✨ What made you laugh today?
🍎 Who did you sit with at lunch?
🏃‍♂️ What was the hardest part of today?
💡 Did anything surprise you?

A simple question can open the door to a much bigger conversation. One answer can lead to stories about friendships, worries, funny moments, school struggles, confidence, kindness, and things they may never have thought to mention on their own. 🫶

And sometimes, your child doesn’t need you to immediately fix the problem. They just need to know that you’re interested, that you’re listening, and that their little everyday experiences matter to you. ❤️

Those small conversations in the car, at dinner, before bed, or while walking home can become the moments they remember most. 🌱👨‍👩‍👦

Ask less for a report. Ask more for a story. Listen without rushing to solve. ❤️

Because behind a one-word “fine” might be a whole story waiting to come out. 🥰✨

#Parenting #ParentingTips #PositiveParenting #ConsciousParenting #GentleParenting
